The '''Lair of the Crystal''' was a cave located beneath the [[Temple Ruins (Mustafar)|Jedi Temple Ruins]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a spacer allied with the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] [[Mission on Mustafar|defeated]] [[Vartonis]] and the [[Brotherhood Mortalis]] in the lair.<ref name="SWG:FotG" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Lair of the Crystal was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FotG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Lair of the Crystal were added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:FotG" />
